defs.def: to send sth from your hand through the air by moving your hand or arm quickly 投；掷；抛；扔

ex.s: As we all sat there _____52_____, a fisherman pulled up, threw us a rope and towed (拖) us back.
ex.t: 当我们都坐在那里_____52_____时，一位渔夫驶过来，扔给我们一根绳子，把我们拖了回去。

ex.s: Small children are easy to throw up in the air and catch-and they ____16____ it.
ex.t: 小孩子很容易被抛向空中再接住——他们也____16____喜欢这样做。

ex.s: He throws his arms and legs out ____17____ he were flying, his eyes wide with ____18____.
ex.t: 他张开双臂双腿好像____17____他在飞一样，眼睛睁得大大的充满____18____。

ex.s: Soon after moving to Switzerland, I ____11____(throw) a house-warming party and was greatly surprised when all 30 guests showed up ____12____(exact) on time.
ex.t: 搬到瑞士后不久，我____11__(throw)举办了一个乔迁派对，结果30位客人都____12__(exact)准时到达，让我大吃一惊。

defs.def: to put sth in a particular place quickly and carelessly 摔；丢；扔

ex.s: Jenna threw the burnt piece into the sink and put in the other slice of bread.
ex.t: 詹娜把烤焦的那片扔进   水池，又放进去另一片面包。

ex.s: Jenna threw the burnt piece into the  sink and put in the other slice of bread.
ex.t: 詹娜把烤焦的那片扔进   水池，又放进去另一片面包。

ex.s: We passed it, he tried to put it in his mouth, he tried bouncing it, rolling it, sitting on it, throwing it.
ex.t: 我们通过它,他试图把它放进他的嘴里, 他试图弹出它,滚动它,坐在它上,扔它。

defs.def: to move sth suddenly and with force 猛推；使劲撞
to move your body or part of it quickly or suddenly 猛动（头、臂、腿）；挺起（胸）；仰起（头）；挥动（拳头、手臂）
to make sb fall quickly or violently to the ground 使迅猛地摔倒在地
to make sb/sth be in a particular state 使处于，使陷入（某种状态）

ex.s: But she expects using the chemical in some kind of industrial process — not simply “millions of worms thrown on top of the plastic.”
ex.t: 但是,她期望在某种工业过程中使用该化学品,而不是简单地说“在塑料上扔上数百万颗蠕虫 ” 。

defs.def: to direct sth at sb/sth 把 … 对准；向 … 作出；对 … 施加
to make sb feel upset, confused, or surprised 使心烦意乱；使困惑；使惊奇
to roll a dice or let it fall after shaking it; to obtain a particular number in this way 掷（色子）；掷出（色子的点数）

ex.s: “Again, Daddy, again!” Jacky shouts as I throw him skywards and catch him on the way back down again.
ex.t: “再来，爸爸，再来！”当我把杰基抛向空中又在落回时接住他，他喊道。

defs.def: to make a clay pot, dish, etc. on a potter's wheel （在陶钧上）把 … 拉制成坯
to send light or shade onto sth 照射（光线）；投射（阴影）
to make your voice sound as if it is coming from another person or place 使变音；使嗓音听起来像来自他人（或别处）

ex.s: He quickly   63   （throw）his tools aside, and started running, arms out.
ex.t: 他迅速   63   （扔）下工具，张开双臂跑了起来。

ex.s: The person who bought the house or moved is the one who throws the panty.
ex.t: 买房或搬家的人就是扔吊带袜的人。

ex.s: Should you come across waste paper thrown out of a passing car, pick it up.
ex.t: 如果你碰到从路过车里扔出的废纸，捡起来。

defs.def: to hit sb with your fist 挥拳猛击；出拳
to move a switch, handle, etc. to operate sth 按动，扳动，推动（开关、操作杆等）
to have a sudden period of bad-tempered behaviour, violent emotion, etc. 突然发作（脾气等）
to give a party 举行聚会
to deliberately lose a game or contest that you should have won 故意输掉（本应获胜的比赛或竞赛）

ex.s: They’re the little spots of color like throw pillows, mirrors and baskets that most of us use to add visual interest to our rooms.
ex.t: 它们是像抱枕、镜子和篮子那样的小色块，我们大多数人都用它们为房间增添视觉趣味。

ex.s: But this doesn't mean that we should throw the baby out with the bathwater.
ex.t: 但这并不意味着我们应该把婴儿和洗澡水一起倒掉（因噎废食）。

defs.def: to rush violently at sth/sb 冲向（人或物）；向 … 猛扑过去
to be too enthusiastic in trying to attract a sexual partner 通常指女人
to get rid of sth that you no longer want 扔掉；丢弃；抛弃

ex.s: Don’t throw away your beginner art.
ex.t: 不要扔掉你的入门艺术作品。

ex.s: She sobbed loudly as I threw the cake away.
ex.t: 我扔掉蛋糕时，她大声抽泣。

ex.s: As we accumulated more devices, however, we didn’t throw out our old ones.
ex.t: 然而，随着我们积累更多设备，我们并没有扔掉旧的。

ex.s: Recycle or Throw Away
ex.t: 回收或扔掉

ex.s: Last October , while tending her garden in Mora , Sweden , Lena Pahlsson pulled out a handful of small   56  (carrot) and was about to throw them away.
ex.t: 去年十月，在瑞典莫拉打理花园时，莉娜·帕尔松拔出一把小胡萝卜，正要扔掉。

ex.s: In a throwaway economy, you would throw away 5,475 cans over the car’s 15-year lifetime.
ex.t: 在一个一次性经济中，在汽车15年的使用寿命里，你会扔掉5475个罐子。

ex.s: Even worse, I had unthinkingly bought way too much; I could have made six salads with what I threw out.
ex.t: 更糟的是，我不知不觉买得太多；我扔掉的东西本可以做六份沙拉。

ex.s: Does your soul die a little every time you throw away unused food?
ex.t: 每次你扔掉没用过的食物，你的灵魂会不会死掉一点点？

ex.s: Without the education I was throwing away, I’d turn to theft and go to prison.
ex.t: 没有我正在抛弃的那份教育，我会走上偷窃之路，进监狱。

ex.s: Up to 84.3% is simply thrown out.
ex.t: 高达84.3%被直接扔掉。

ex.s: I was about to throw everything away when my mother came in.
ex.t: 我正要把一切扔掉，母亲进来了。

defs.def: to fail to make use of sth; to waste sth 失去；错过；浪费；白费

ex.s: lost contact withD. thrown light on
ex.t: 失去与D的联络 闪光了

defs.def: to include sth with what you are selling or offering, without increasing the price （不提高售价或报价的）奉送，额外赠送
to add a remark to a conversation 加插评语（或感叹句等）
to manage to get rid of sth/sb that is making you suffer, annoying you, etc. 摆脱；甩掉
to take off a piece of clothing quickly and carelessly 匆匆脱掉，拽下，扯掉（衣服）
to allow people to enter or visit a place where they could not go before （对 … ）开放；允许 … 进入

ex.s: But they weren’t there to throw red paint on fur-coat-wearing film stars.
ex.t: 但他们不是在那里向穿着毛衣的电影明星扔红漆。

ex.s: Single-use plastic bags are used at most a few times before they   4   (throw) away.
ex.t: 一次性塑料袋最多使用几次就会被___4___（throw）掉。

defs.def: to allow people to discuss sth, take part in a competition, etc. 允许 … 公开（讨论）；允许 … 参加（竞赛）
to say sth in a way that suggests you have not given it a lot of thought 脱口而出；随口说
to decide not to accept a proposal, an idea, etc. 拒不接受，否决（建议、想法等）

ex.s: Morgan says，”To give people a guilt-free option that they can wear without someone throwing paint on them-1 think that’s going to be a massive thing, at least here in New York.” Designer Jennifer Anderson admits it took her a while to come around to the opinion that using nutria fur for her creations is morally acceptable.
ex.t: 摩根说：“给人们一种毫无愧疚感的选择，让他们穿上也不会被人泼油漆——我认为这会是一件大事，至少在纽约这里。”设计师詹妮弗·安德森承认，她花了一段时间才接受在其创作中使用海狸鼠毛皮在道德上可以接受的观点。

defs.def: to produce smoke, light, heat, etc. 冒（烟）；发（光）；散发出（热）
to confuse sth or make it wrong 使混淆不清；打乱；使出错
to vomit food 呕出（食物）

ex.s: It’s jaw-dropping how much perfectly good food is thrown away — from “ugly” (but quite eatable) vegetables rejected by grocers to large amounts of uneaten dishes thrown into restaurant garbage cans.
ex.t: 令人咋舌的是，多少完好的食物被扔掉——从杂货商拒收的“丑”（但完全可吃）蔬菜，到大量倒进餐厅垃圾桶的剩菜。

ex.s: This crocodile is used to passengers throwing food from boats and now she is becoming familiar with humans.
ex.t: 这条鳄鱼习惯了乘客从船上扔食物，现在她正变得熟悉人类。

defs.def: to make people notice sth 使显眼；使引起注意
to build sth suddenly or in a hurry 突然建造；匆忙建造
to leave your job 辞职
the act of throwing sth, especially a ball or dice 抛；扔；摔；投（球）；掷（色子）

ex.s: Summers in the mid-70s were spent at home shooting baskets, hitting a baseball, or throwing a football, preparing for my future as a quarterback on a football team.
ex.t: 70年代中期的夏天，我都在家里投篮、打棒球或扔橄榄球，为我将来当橄榄球队四分卫做准备。

ex.s: Hours later, the waves rose up over our ship, breaking it into two and throwing us overboard.
ex.t: 数小时后,海浪冲上我们的船 撞成两块把我们扔下船

defs.def: the distance which sth is thrown 投掷的距离
a loose cloth cover that can be thrown over a sofa, etc. （沙发等的）套，罩

ex.s: Hoping to impress some talented actors to come and work for me for nothing, I spread some throws over the sofas and lit candles to make it seem a bit more “young professional”.
ex.t: 为了给一些有才华的演员留下印象、让他们免费来为我工作，我在沙发上铺了些盖毯、点了蜡烛，让地方显得更“年轻职业范儿”一些。

ex.s: We 3____ (throw) her a big birthday party!
ex.t: 我们3____（throw 举办）她一个盛大的生日派对！
